questions.prompt: Why can summing process RSS overstate fleet memory?
options: Shared pages can be counted in multiple processes
questions.explanation: RSS includes resident shared pages per process. PSS apportions them and is useful alongside other memory measurements.

questions.prompt: What should a controlled shutdown allow active jobs to do?
options: Start an unlimited number of new jobs
Finish or reach a defined drain deadline
questions.explanation: Draining stops accepting work while existing sessions finish, subject to deployment timeout policy.

questions.prompt: What should justify a worker load threshold?
options: The course’s example as a universal limit
Measured behaviour under the intended workload
The largest value the configuration accepts
questions.explanation: A threshold is a workload-dependent admission signal. Validate it against latency, resources and failures.
